data.dataSource: World Bank Open Data API (official WDI indicators)

indicators.label: GDP growth
indicators.whyItMatters: Shows how quickly real output is expanding after inflation.

indicators.label: Inflation
indicators.whyItMatters: High inflation erodes purchasing power and often forces tighter monetary policy.

indicators.label: Exports of goods & services
indicators.whyItMatters: Export intensity is a proxy for foreign-exchange earning capacity.

indicators.label: Total reserves
indicators.whyItMatters: Import-cover months indicate the external buffer available during FX stress.

indicators.label: Current account balance
indicators.whyItMatters: Persistent deficits increase dependence on financing and rollovers.

indicators.label: Tax revenue
indicators.whyItMatters: Tax-to-GDP indicates the state capacity available to fund services and debt costs.

data.methodologyNote: Peer comparison values are the latest non-null annual World Development Indicators observation available for each country and indicator. Years can differ by country because official annual data is released at different times.
